name: M. P. Tuohy
description: Documented New Zealand GIS and spatial-information contribution, 1993–2000.
story: M. P. Tuohy is credited with C. S. N. Priyono and A. S. Palmer on a 1993 New Zealand Soil News account of GIS for farm soil conservation planning near Āpiti. The work described geographic information systems as tools for planning and spatial decision-making.

Tuohy is also named with I. J. Yule, A. G. Gillingham, J. P. Praat and M. J. Hedley as a co-author of 'Precision Agriculture Applications in New Zealand' in Massey University's February 2000 Fertilizer and Lime Research Centre workshop proceedings. The available records do not establish full given names or Tuohy's individual tasks.
